summary: Iteration 15 — verified (1) /learn/:topic blank-screen fix (FoundingBanner import) and (2) new GET /api/founding-status/widget HTML embed endpoint + TIP checkout package_id surfacing. Backend: 4/4 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_founding_widget.py (founding-status JSON shape, widget HTML body with branding+spots+CTA, widget headers for iframe embedding, TIP checkout session creates with package_id='tip' that flows through to /checkout/status/{session_id}). Frontend: /learn/propagation renders title 'Propagation', intro body, paywall CTA, FoundingBanner ('30 of 30 spots left'). /learn/pest-control (substituted for non-existent 'companion-planting' slug) also renders cleanly with banner. Clicking learn-unlock-btn opens PaywallModal ([data-testid=paywall-modal] confirmed visible with 'Keep growing — pick your tier' content). No React stack traces, no console errors on the working routes.

minor.issue: Backend correctly sends `Cache-Control: public, max-age=60` (verified at origin localhost:8001) but the Cloudflare/preview ingress rewrites it to `no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate` before reaching external iframe embedders. Cross-origin iframe still works because `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors *` IS preserved through the proxy. Net effect: embed functions but loses the 60s edge-cache benefit on this preview host (likely fine on production patchandpot.app).

The CTA host is resolved from `request.headers['host']` which yields the internal cluster URL (e.g. `grow-by-season-1.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud/?founding=1`) instead of the user-facing domain (`grow-by-season-1.preview.emergentagent.com`). Path/query (`/?founding=1`) is correct. Embedded users on third-party sites would be redirected to the cluster URL. Consider using `request.headers.get('x-forwarded-host')` first, or pin to a configured PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN env var.

action_items: (Optional) Use x-forwarded-host or a PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN env var to build the widget CTA URL so iframe-embedded clicks land on the public domain instead of the internal cluster host.

(Informational) The review request mentioned slug 'companion-planting' as a second static masterclass — that slug does not exist in ALL_MASTERCLASSES (valid static slugs: propagation, pest-control, plant-care, seasonal-planting). Test was run against /learn/pest-control instead and passed identically. Not a code bug; just a slug mismatch in the request.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/checkout.py:42-136 — the widget endpoint is clean, self-contained, and correctly returns 204 when sold out so embedders can hide the iframe. CSP frame-ancestors:* is the correct embed contract.
LearnLanding.jsx:11,272 — FoundingBanner import + bottom-of-page mount fix is correct. Banner is appropriately gated on `!paid` so paid visitors don't see redundant urgency.
FoundingBanner.jsx — clean fail-closed pattern: returns null if status fetch fails or cohort is full. No retry storm on the home page.

Widget HTML's CTA URL derivation uses Host header without checking X-Forwarded-Host first — fine on production direct hosting, surfaces the internal cluster hostname behind the preview ingress. Low impact (path is still correct).
